system.name: HyperEdge
system.one_liner: an edge CDN that streams video from underutilized third-party 'Hdevices' coordinated by a centralized tracker alongside an external CDN

components.name: External CDN
components.role: black-box CDN that stores all videos and serves the initial fast segments

components.name: Client
components.role: client-side library on end-user devices that downloads video from the CDN and Hdevices and reassembles it for playback

components.name: Tracker
components.role: centralized, geo-distributed system that maps videos to Hdevices and applies content-distribution policy

components.name: Index Map
components.role: maps video IDs to the Hdevices storing them

components.name: State Database
components.role: stores Hdevice status and video popularity state

components.name: Frequency Statistics
components.role: records per-video download frequency over five-minute intervals as a popularity metric

components.name: Resource Allocation
components.role: tallies available Hdevice resources per region and combines them with popularity to derive caching distribution

components.name: Dedicated server cluster
components.role: servers that run the geo-distributed Tracker

components.name: HyperEdge Device
components.role: third-party device with underutilized compute, storage and network resources that passively stores and serves video (Hdevice)

components.name: Fetch Video
components.role: Hdevice fetches a newly assigned video using a download protocol analogous to the client library and stores it locally

flows.what: requests the first few segments of the target video (Startup)
request containing the target video ID
list of Hdevices storing the video (Location)
connection establishment, with NAT punching if needed
remaining video segments downloaded concurrently via multipath parallel transmission
piggybacked list of new video IDs to cache
reports completion of the new video download (Finish)

content.key_idea: A centralized Tracker matches client video requests to nearby underutilized Hdevices and pushes caching decisions to them, so clients download most of a video's segments in parallel from Hdevices instead of the External CDN.
content.reading_order: Top-left legend, then Client (bottom-left) exchanging Video-ID/location messages with the Tracker (top) and connecting to the HyperEdge Device (bottom-right), while the Tracker separately pushes caching decisions to the HyperEdge Device.

evidence: The HyperEdge system consists of a client-side library that runs on end-user devices, a tracker cluster deployed in ByteDance
the client receives video data concurrently from all connected Hdevices using a multipath transmission scheme
the tracker piggybacks a list of new video IDs that the Hdevice should cache

summary: HyperEdge is an edge CDN infrastructure that reduces cost by streaming short videos mainly from underutilized third-party 'Hdevices' rather than an external CDN. Figure 2 shows the overall architecture and its two workflows. In video downloading, the Client library starts fetching a video from the External CDN while asking the Tracker for the video's ID; the Tracker returns a list of Hdevices holding the video, and the Client connects to them (with NAT punching if needed) to download the remaining segments over a multipath parallel transmission scheme. In content distribution, the Tracker's Index Map and State Database, informed by per-video Frequency Statistics and Resource Allocation, decide which videos each Hdevice should cache; Hdevices report status via periodic heartbeats and fetch newly assigned videos, reporting completion back to the Tracker.
summary_zh: 该图展示HyperEdge边缘CDN架构：客户端向Tracker请求视频ID，Tracker返回Hdevice列表供其NAT穿透并行下载；Tracker还依热度与资源分配决定各Hdevice缓存内容，Hdevice心跳上报并拉取新视频。
notes: layout-proposal: coordinator-with-direct-links — Client and HyperEdge Device connect directly to each other in addition to each connecting to the Tracker, so the arrangement is closer to a small 3-node mesh (Client, Tracker, HyperEdge Device) with the Tracker as coordinator than a pure hub-and-spoke.
